title: Man Made Language Models? Evaluating LLMs' Perpetuation of Masculine Generics Bias
abstract: arXiv:2502.10577v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Instruct-based large language models (LLMs) have been shown to propagate and even amplify gender bias when prompted with contextually constrained instructions (e.g., writing a text from a description or selecting a gendered pronoun). However, little attention has been paid to biases in responses to contextually unconstrained (generic) instructions conveyed by gendered language, particularly masculine generics (MG). MG, found in many gender-marked languages, denote the use of the masculine gender as a supposedly neutral reference to mixed-gender groups or individuals whose gender is unknown or non-binary. Yet, psycholinguistic studies demonstrate that MG are not neutral and systematically induce gender bias. This study investigates how both local and proprietary LLMs are MG-biased when responding to generic prompts in French, examining LLMs' MG bias rates and use of gender-fair language (GFL). We create a 16k+ human noun databas

translated_title: 人类制造的男性化语言模型？评估大语言模型对阳性泛指偏见的延续
translated_abstract: 基于指令的大语言模型（LLMs）已被证明在接收到上下文受限的指令（例如，根据描述撰写文本或选择性别代词）时会传播甚至放大性别偏见。然而，对于响应由性别化语言所传达的上下文不受限（泛指性）指令时产生的偏见，尤其是阳性泛指偏见，却鲜有关注。阳性泛指存在于许多具有性别标记的语言中，指使用阳性形式作为对混合性别群体或性别未知/非二元性别个体的所谓中性指称。然而，心理语言学研究证明，阳性泛指并非中性，且会系统性地引发性别偏见。本研究调查了本地部署和专有的大语言模型在响应法语泛指性提示时如何表现出阳性泛指偏见，考察了模型的阳性泛指偏见率及其对性别公平语言（GFL）的使用情况。我们创建了一个包含超过1.6万个人类名词的数据库……
tldr: 本研究通过法语泛指性提示的测试发现，无论开源还是商业大语言模型都会延续阳性泛指带来的性别偏见，且极少使用性别公平语言进行回应。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that both open-source and proprietary LLMs perpetuate masculine generics bias when responding to generic prompts in French, and they rarely employ gender-fair language.
